description: Packaging-only aggregation of original independent runs. No new execution, run ID, score, response or task checksum has been created. Control trials (oracle/nop) are original Harbor CLI jobs; candidate model trials were produced by the local Outside-Harbor runner (deliverables/2026-10-04_outside-harbor-win/runner/runner.py) and are archived verbatim.
parent_zip_note: 本归档打包出的 <task>-jobs-archive-v1.1.0.zip 的 sha256 见同名 .sha256 文件；lock.json 位于 zip 内部，无法记录自身容器的 hash
task_hash_platform_algorithm: sha256 over (relative posix path + LF + sha256(file) + LF) for every file of the task tree sorted by path, excluding jobs/ and platform_import.json
task_hash_runner_algorithm: sha256 over (relative posix path + NUL + sha256(file) + LF) for every file sorted by path, excluding jobs/, runs/, work/, results/ and caches (same as runner.py compute_task_hash / jobs/<trial>/binding.json)
source_mapping_note: jobs/lock.json 自身不在 source_mapping 内（避免自引用哈希）

run_time_identity.task_hash_algorithm: sha256 over (relative posix path + sha256(file content)) for every file in the task tree, sorted by path; jobs/, runs/, work/, results/ and caches are excluded
